metadata.description: slopshopper's own Claude Code mods: a slop detector, a fuel gauge, a secret shield, a tripwire for destructive commands, session receipts, and a test pulse.

plugins.name: slop-detector
plugins.description: Refuses edits that replace code with a '... rest of the code' placeholder and tracks TODO stubs, debug prints and other leftovers above the prompt and in /slop.

plugins.name: burn-rate
plugins.description: A fuel gauge above the prompt: context fill, tokens, dollars, dollars per hour, your plan's window, a sparkline of the last turns.

plugins.name: secret-shield
plugins.description: Redacts API keys, tokens and private keys from tool results before Claude reads them, and refuses writes and commands that embed one.

plugins.name: tripwire
plugins.description: Holds rm -rf, force pushes, git reset --hard, DROP TABLE, curl | sh, sudo and .env edits behind a question; refuses the unrecoverable ones.

plugins.name: receipts
plugins.description: A ledger of files touched and commands run, counted on the spinner, printed as Markdown by /receipts.

plugins.name: test-pulse
plugins.description: Runs the test suite after every turn that changed source and keeps the result above the prompt.
